Remove ONLY the entire peach cushion, circular metallic platform, paw logo on the cushion, and any background. Reconstruct the small lower silhouette only where it was occluded by the cushion so the original four paws and tail sit naturally on a flat invisible ground line. Keep the original cat's pose, identity, fur rendering, lighting and fine fur edges; do not stylize or redesign the cat, add a different animal, change the eyes, duplicate body parts or add accessories. Isolated single cat, ears and tail fully included, generous tiny transparent margin, close crop vertically, centered portrait composition. A genuine alpha-transparent PNG, no white/black/checkerboard background painted into pixels, no floor, no backdrop, no text, no speech bubble, no hearts, no stars, no pad, no disk, no pedestal, no shadow outside the natural paw contact. Production-quality fur alpha edges.

idle-mask.png.prompt: Create an exact grayscale segmentation matte of the supplied image for production compositing. Output a binary-style monochrome MASK IMAGE, not a cat illustration. Keep the EXACT original canvas size 1207 by 1303 and exact silhouette/position: all pixels belonging to the whole cat, including ears, whiskers, paws, long fluffy tail, collar, medallion, fur, eyes and every interior detail must be solid pure white #ffffff (featureless white silhouette). Every pixel outside the cat, including ALL checkerboard pattern, must be solid pure black #000000. Only the very thin antialiased fur edge may use grayscale. No transparent output is needed. No face details, no eye holes, no body shading, no checker pattern, no floor, no text, no border. The result must look like one featureless white silhouette of THIS seated cat on a uniform solid black canvas, aligned precisely to the reference pixel positions.

sleeping.png.prompt:

Edit target: the supplied 1207 by 1303 full-body white longhair desktop cat image.
